name: @streamlinelabs/testcontainers
description: Testcontainers module for Streamline - The Redis of Streaming

scripts.smoke:cjs: node -e "const s=require('./dist/index.js'); const missing=['StreamlineContainer','StartedStreamlineContainer'].filter(k=>s[k]===undefined); if(missing.length){console.error('CJS build is missing exports: '+missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('Testcontainers CJS require smoke test OK');"
scripts.smoke:esm: node -e "import('./dist/index.mjs').then(m=>{const missing=['StreamlineContainer','StartedStreamlineContainer'].filter(k=>m[k]===undefined); if(missing.length){console.error('ESM build is missing exports: '+missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('Testcontainers ESM import smoke test OK');}).catch(e=>{console.error(e); process.exit(1);});"
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:cjs && npm run smoke:esm
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

author: Streamline Team <team@streamline.dev>
